observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with theatrical lighting, a large screen in the background showing canyon scenery, and a seated audience in front
observation.dancers: large group of mixed men and women, youth and adults
observation.formation_and_space: starts in a horizontal line across the stage, transitions into circles and rotating formations, and forms a human pyramid structure
observation.posture: upright torso, erect posture, knees slightly flexed during stepping
observation.footwork: energetic stepping, high knee lifts and marching in place, traveling steps on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: hands held linked in lines or circles, arms extended shoulder-height or raised overhead, some gestures with a red flag
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip movement, upright torso maintained throughout
observation.partnering: dancers hold hands in line and circle formations with adjacent dancers
observation.levels_jumps_turns: level changes include dancers crouching low and a multi-tiered human pyramid where men climb onto shoulders
observation.costume_and_props: men in black tunics with white and gold embroidery, black trousers, and boots; women in gold and brown long dresses with patterned panels and small crowns/headpieces; red flag held by a male dancer
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details of individual dancers during fast group spinning

signature_moments.what: Dancers march in a straight line across the stage holding hands, lifting knees high on the beat.
